about: Bolshoye Savino: the only airport in Perm Krai with scheduled passenger flights, 17 km from Perm. The new 31,000 sq. m terminal was built in 2017 and is designed for 2 million passengers a year. One runway 3,204 × 49 m.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 108 Bus Station — Bolshoye Savino Airport: from the airport (terminal A) from 06:00 to 23:45, from Perm bus station from 05:55 to 23:00; on weekends and holidays the last trips are earlier. Intercity No. 822 connects the airport with Perm-2 station, Berezniki and Usolye.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage for baggage on Level 1, on the right side of the terminal, in the domestic arrivals area. Open round the clock, payment according to the airport price list.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The mother and child room is open round the clock and free, for departing and arriving passengers. Admits children under 7 with one adult, children with disabilities under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy. Go to the information desk; leave baggage and pushchairs at left luggage in advance.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Short-stay central car park: up to 15 minutes free, up to an hour 300 ₽, up to 24 hours 500 ₽, then 500 ₽ per 24 hours. Long-stay: up to 10 minutes free, up to 24 hours 400 ₽, then 400 ₽ per 24 hours. An incomplete hour or 24-hour period is charged in full.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi with speed limits throughout the airport building, no login or password. Select the Saturn-R network and open a browser.
